notes:
Account background: mid-market product analytics vendor, shipping AI features (in-app assistant, doc summarization, semantic search). Started with Redwood hosted API evaluation in Feb — quick POC for chat and embeddings. Liked latency and token-cost transparency.

POC summary: hosted API POC (2 weeks) -> validated quality for short-form chat, embeddings for topic clustering. Performance: median 85-110ms p50 for short requests in hosted region, acceptable. Next asked for Dedicated for predictability/throughput and stricter VPC controls.

Pricing thread highlights: AE presented Dedicated pricing options (monthly commit tiers: 0.5 GPU equiv / 1 GPU / 2 GPU) + 20% burst pool, overage at tier rate * 1.5. Customer wants a lower starting commit + predictable ramp schedule across quarters. Finance asked for ramp (Q1 25%, Q2 50%, Q3 75%, Q4 100%) and a blended overage floor.

Customer quotes: "We need guaranteed throughput for peak onboarding flows — can't have degraded rerank latency during import jobs." Also: "Major ask: VPC private control plane + audit logs with 12 mo retention."

Security: completed initial security questionnaire. SOC2 in place, but procurement insists on KMS integration and explicit data residency commitment for EU customers. Legal requested sample DPA and incident SLA examples (sent drive links).

Commercial posture: motivated to commit but price-sensitive. Competing internal option: keep hosted for now and autoscale own caching/queuing; however they prefer Redwood's unified ops if price/ramp aligns.

Stated risks: procurement timelines (6-8 weeks), custom SOW negotiations, technical validation of VPC peering and E2E latency within their EU region.
